nodes.name: When Called by WF1
nodes.notes:
Input from WF1 (new lead via WhatsApp):
{
  phone: '5215512345678',
  pushName: 'Maria Garcia',
  text: 'Hola, me interesa la propiedad en Polanco',
  messageId: '3EB0A0...'
}

parameters.query:
-- Create a new conversation and check day/night in one query.
-- Migration 0005 dropped UNIQUE on lead_phone, so we always INSERT.
INSERT INTO conversations (
  lead_phone, lead_name, current_property, mode, source, arrived_during
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3,
  CASE WHEN is_daytime() THEN 'pending_assignment' ELSE 'night_queued' END,
  'whatsapp_direct',
  CASE WHEN is_daytime() THEN 'day' ELSE 'night' END
)
RETURNING
  conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, current_property,
  mode, arrived_during, is_daytime() AS is_day;

-- Link the inbound message (inserted by WF1 with conversation_id=NULL)
-- to the newly created conversation.
UPDATE messages
SET conversation_id = $1::uuid, sender_type = 'lead'
WHERE msg_external_id = $2
RETURNING message_id;

-- Find a matching property from the listings table.
-- M5 fix: require search_terms >= 5 chars to prevent overly broad ILIKE matches.
SELECT id, listing_hash, title, price, price_numeric, currency,
       location, property_type, operation_type, bedrooms, bathrooms,
       area_m2, description, url, image_url
FROM listings
WHERE is_active = true
  AND (
    listing_hash = $1
    OR (length($2) >= 5 AND title ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
    OR (length($2) >= 5 AND location ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%')
    OR url ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  )
ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO properties_cache (property_id, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (property_id) DO UPDATE
  SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, fetched_at = NOW();

-- Switch conversation to AI mode for night bot.
UPDATE conversations SET mode = 'ai' WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid;

nodes.name: Call WF4: AI Night Bot
nodes.notes:
Start AI conversation for night WhatsApp leads.
WF4 sends initial greeting with property info.
Subsequent messages from this lead will route to WF4 via WF1 (mode=ai).
